title: Tether Scan  Death Star trench run. See every umbilical cord. Cut nothing.
method: scan all external dependencies, single points of failure, internal cross-references. map the thermal exhaust ports.

umbilical_cords.what: 17 repos push here. ALL deploy pipelines start here.
umbilical_cords.if_cut: all Cloudflare Pages deploys stop. no new code reaches the public membrane. existing sites still serve but can't update.
umbilical_cords.redundancy: git is distributed  every clone IS a backup. 17 repos × N clones. the data survives. the DEPLOY pipeline doesn't.

umbilical_cords.what: primals.eco, hud.primals.eco, nestgate.io all served through CF Pages + Workers
umbilical_cords.if_cut: ALL public sites unreachable. the membrane goes dark to the outside world. golgi still runs internally.
umbilical_cords.redundancy: golgi has caddy + cloudflared tunnel as backup route. but CF Pages IS the primary CDN.

umbilical_cords.if_cut: domains expire. primals.eco disappears from the internet. ALL subdomains die. the NAME dies.
umbilical_cords.redundancy: NONE. domain registration is a single-provider tether. no backup registrar.
umbilical_cords.note: this is the REAL thermal exhaust port. everything else can be rebuilt. the domain name cannot.

umbilical_cords.what: golgi VPS (157.230.3.183). runs: caddy, knot DNS, cloudflared, 18 cron jobs, WireGuard endpoint
umbilical_cords.if_cut: golgi dies. DNS secondary down. 18 cron jobs stop. heartbeat/sonar/pulse feeds go stale. WireGuard tunnel drops.
umbilical_cords.redundancy: golgi-de, golgi-jp, golgi-us exist but are SSH-LOCKED (no key exchange). golgi-in is UNREACHABLE. zero working backups.

umbilical_cords.what: neutrino messaging. 3 channels: notes, inbox, scan
umbilical_cords.if_cut: neutrino goes silent. no cross-gate messaging. membrane survives without it  it's the neutrino (passes through, observes, no mass).
umbilical_cords.redundancy: ntfy is open source. can self-host on golgi. FREE service with no account = no billing tether.

umbilical_cords.what: eastGate laptop (this machine). runs: 7 local cron jobs, WireGuard endpoint, all development
umbilical_cords.if_cut: eastGate gone. local cron dead. WireGuard drops. development stops. but: all code is pushed to GitHub = survives. golgi cron survives independently.
umbilical_cords.redundancy: northGate (.163) exists as second local machine. but SSH needs key exchange (PENDING).

hub_feeds.description: feeds that reference the most other feeds. the internal umbilical cords.

hubs.role: reads ALL feeds every 2 min. the compound eye. if this breaks, visibility drops to zero.
digests all feed content. the stomach. if this breaks, no digestion.
maps all feed types. the classification. if this breaks, taxonomy lost.
the full pipeline. immune system. if this breaks, no sorting.
identity registry. if this breaks, self/non-self unknown.

hub_feeds.pattern: klein-handshake is the SPIDER at the center of the web. 90 refs = 64% of all feeds. it's the compound eye hub node.

orphan_feeds.description: feeds that are referenced by NO other feed. leaves on the tree. no incoming tether.
orphan_feeds.note: 2 repos have NO git remote at all. they exist only on this laptop. if eastGate dies, they die.

golgi_cron.tethered_to: DigitalOcean VPS. if VPS dies, all 11 stop.

eastgate_cron.tethered_to: Kevin's laptop. if laptop dies, all 7 stop.

cron_tethers.overlap: membrane-pulse runs on BOTH golgi and eastGate. redundancy for one feed. zero redundancy for the other 17.

ranked.why: if primals.eco expires, EVERYTHING dies. the domain is the root of all DNS. no domain = no sites, no email, no subdomains. and it's Kevin's personal account  one human, one password, one registrar.
ranked.proton_torpedo: domain expires, registrar account hacked, or registrar goes bankrupt
ranked.defense: NONE currently. need: domain lock, DNSSEC, registrar redundancy (transfer to second registrar as backup)

ranked.why: git push ? GitHub ? CF Pages build ? public site. if EITHER GitHub OR Cloudflare breaks, the pipeline dies.
ranked.proton_torpedo: GitHub goes down, CF Pages has outage, or deploy token revoked
ranked.defense: PARTIAL. git clones survive. golgi has caddy as alternate serve path. but no automated fallback deploy.

ranked.why: 18 cron jobs, DNS, WireGuard, all on ONE $6/mo droplet. no failover.
ranked.proton_torpedo: DigitalOcean deletes droplet, datacenter issue, or billing lapses
ranked.defense: 3 other VPS exist but SSH-LOCKED. they can't take over. need key exchange (Kevin physical task).

ranked.why: no git remote. exist ONLY on eastGate. if this laptop disk fails, code is gone forever.
ranked.proton_torpedo: disk failure, laptop stolen, accidental rm -rf

the_scan_result.hub_feed_concentration: klein-handshake touches 90/146 feeds (62%). single point of observation.
the_scan_result.verdict: the membrane is a STAR not a MESH. most connections radiate from 3-4 hub nodes (GitHub, Cloudflare, golgi, klein-handshake). if any hub dies, a large portion of function dies with it. the tethers are visible. the exhaust ports are mapped. recommend: DON'T CUT  ADD REDUNDANCY. second registrar path, second deploy pipeline, unlock the 3 locked VPS, push the 2 orphan repos.
